metadata.name: Microstock Evidence Hub — Canvas Runtime Database
metadata.sourceOfTruth: The uploaded Excel workbook remains the master source of truth. This JSON is a runtime projection for Gemini Canvas.
integrityRules: Do not add AI-generated keywords, third-party keyword lists, guessed demand scores, estimated search volume, or scraped login-protected data.
Original terms are preserved as source truth; Canonical Topic only normalizes obvious naming variants.
Platform Count is the number of platforms with official evidence and is not a demand score.
Current/Historical/Evergreen describes source freshness or recurrence, not sales potential.
Normalized clusters in deep dives are internal taxonomy and must not automatically be treated as official metadata keywords.
Do not combine separate format and topic signals into a fictional combined brief.
important: Runtime keyword records include only Evergreen and Seasonal because those are the current Canvas research routes.
Trend, Content Need, and Format evidence are preserved in the full evidence dataset and are not reclassified as Evergreen or Seasonal.
leadMonths and eventDate remain null unless explicitly present in source data; no dates or lead times are invented.
Allowed derivatives are only exact alternate Original Term strings found in official evidence rows for the same canonical topic/lifecycle.
Adobe production/metadata/submission/quality guide text is not contained in this workbook and is therefore not fabricated in this JSON.

methodology.title: MASTER MICROSTOCK DATASET v1 — METHODOLOGY
methodology.Scope: Adobe Stock, Shutterstock, Freepik, Vecteezy. Official platform/contributor sources only.
methodology.What is included: Official evergreen guidance, content needs, trends, seasonal categories, search-trend keywords, briefs, and Vecteezy challenge archive.
methodology.What is NOT included: AI-generated keywords, third-party keyword lists, guessed demand scores, estimated search volume, or scraped login-protected data.
methodology.Canonical Topic rule: Original terms are always preserved. Canonical Topic only normalizes obvious naming variants (e.g., Families → Family).
methodology.Platform Count: Formula-based count of how many platforms have at least one official evidence row for the canonical topic.
methodology.Current vs Historical: Current = active/current source signal; Historical = archived official signal; Evergreen = explicitly recurring/timeless need.
methodology.Freepik limitation: The strongest Freepik demand feed is official but login-required. Its live rows are intentionally blank until copied from the contributor dashboard.
